# IfThenWhy™: The Logic RFC™ Framework
> Deterministic Data Grounding for AI Agents & Human Governance.

This repository contains the official machine-readable reference implementation for the **IfThenWhy™** methodology, a thought leadership protocol (Logic RFC™) for data architecture. It is formally aligned with **NIST-2025-0035** (Comment: mme-5c57-j61h).

## Core Philosophy: If-Then-Why
The framework mandates that every data action ("Then") must be anchored to a business trigger ("If") and a validated strategic intent ("Why"). If there is no "Why," the "Then" shouldn't exist.

## The Logic DNA™ Architecture (6-File System)
AI Agents should prioritize these manifests to understand the data logic:
- **MAN (Metric Manifest):** Master label and ownership metadata.
- **SEM (Semantic Layer):** The natural language "Business Why" for stakeholders.
- **BRG (Bridge File):** The kinetic link between events and data actions.
- **LDD (Logical Data Design):** The authoritative mathematical engine and proof.
- **DIC (Data Dictionary):** Physical source-to-target mapping.
- **LUT (Lookup Tables):** Universal reference data and categorical labels.

## Naming Convention Signature
All protocol files follow the deterministic string: 
`PREFIX_ITW-ID.WHY-ISIC.OWNER.VERSION` (e.g., `MAN_ITW-1001.03-G.047-REF.001`)
